name: Test stand unavailable
description: Connection errors, timeouts and 5xx answers: the stand or a container was down, not a defect
messageRegex: (?s)(java\.net\.SocketTimeoutException.*|.*(Connection refused|Connect to .* failed|UnknownHostException|connect timed out|Read timed out|net::ERR_|but was <?50[234]).*)

name: Product defects
description: An assertion failed: the application did not behave as the test expects

name: Broken tests
description: An unexpected exception (e.g. an element never appeared): check the test or the page before filing a bug
